files.README.md:
Rowan College - registrar export folders.

exports/ holds the semester extracts the registrar sends to the records
office; exports/archive/ keeps the snapshots taken after each send. For
the duplication audit, two files count as the same record only when their
stored bytes match exactly. Files that merely share a name in different
folders are separate records and are filed independently.

# Export handover notes

The records office asked that every extract keep the same column order
after the spring migration. Column headers were left unchanged, and the
archive snapshots are never edited once they are taken.

turns.prompt: The registrar's records team is preparing the spring 2026 midterm extract for accreditation review. In the export folders, one file appears twice with the same stored bytes. Give the workspace path of one of the two copies. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
